info.name: MahaExam Platform API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for MahaExam Platform APIs (Authentication, Student, Coaching, Admin, Payments, Question Bank, Exams, and Analytics). Configured with automatic environment variable extraction (authToken, attemptId, batchId).
